response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (15+ years) with strong software craftsmanship, but the role demands deep, current C++/STL expertise for industrial automation. His only professional C++ experience was a 7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015; his career since has centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang for web platforms. There is no evidence of secure development lifecycle practice, IEC 62443 familiarity, MQTT/industrial protocols, or Azure — core requirements for this position.
strengths: Extensive experience building low-latency, high-throughput event-driven systems (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, plus mentoring via workshops and courses
Some systems-level background (C/C++ at National Instruments, DLang with async I/O and fibers, embedded exposure)
concerns: Minimal and dated professional C++ experience (~7 months, ended 2015)
No industrial cybersecurity, IEC 62443, or Secure Development Lifecycle experience
No exposure to industrial automation domain or protocols (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus, IEC 61850)

key_factors.factor: Insufficient C++ depth for core requirement
Strong distributed-systems and performance engineering skills
